desc: Parse N, M, A, B and the M bad intervals; build a list of good intervals (gaps between bad intervals and edges).

Implement BFS over good intervals: start with [1,1]; repeatedly expand the reachable right endpoint by merging any good interval whose left endpoint is ≤ current_right + A. Advance an index through the good intervals list (which is sorted) so the process is O(M).
After expansion, check if current_right ≥ N; if so print "Yes", otherwise print "No".
Handle edge cases: M=0 (single good interval [1,N]), ensure square 1 is always good, and include the tail interval after the last bad interval up to N.
Provide final Python solution with `solve()` function reading stdin and printing result.
